title: Cod pepper fry
summary: Cod pepper fry is a indian dinner built around cod fillets and green peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and green peppers before the pan is hot. Cod pepper fry is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry cod fillets until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add green peppers and onions, return cod fillets, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Cod pepper fry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Cod pepper fry served for dinner
